key_concepts: Everything around us is matter, including soil, water, and air.
Matter has different properties that make materials distinct from one another.
Materials are useful when they serve their purpose.
Useful materials may have properties such as durability, flexibility, elasticity, hardness
Many useful materials can be reused or recycled.
Some useful materials can also be harmful if not handled properly.
Broken glass can cause cuts or injury.
Toxic substances may be present in common items such as paints, cleaners, fumes, gels, or
Product labels help consumers identify whether a product is useful or harmful.
Expiration dates and hazardous signs are important parts of product labels.
Flammable products such as paints must be stored away from open flames.
Corrosive products like muriatic acid should be kept away from children's reach.
